hints.title: Pair Partitioning
hints.text: Every valid partition of even-length substrings can be further decomposed into disjoint pairs of length 2.

hints.title: Pair Homogeneity
hints.text: For every adjacent non-overlapping pair s[2i] and s[2i+1], both characters must match.

hints.title: Greedy Mismatch Count
hints.text: If s[2i] does not equal s[2i+1], we must perform at least 1 change to make them equal.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: length of binary string s
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining higher-order even blocks is redundant since length-2 parity determines minimal changes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Decompose arbitrary even partitions into basic blocks of size 2.
